title_en: I Brought You a Young Bride
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. 'Ај да ме, мајко, керодсаш' is unclear to me; 'керодсаш' looks like a garbled or dialect word and my reading is only a guess at 'give a joyful trill/cheer'. 'Чеда' is plural of 'чедо' (child).

lines.en: Open the gates, mother,
let my friends come in,

lines.cyr: песни да запееме, оро да заиграме,
lines.lat: pesni da zapeeme, oro da zaigrame,
lines.en: let us sing songs, let us dance the oro,
songs and dances of Macedonia.
I brought you a young bride,

lines.cyr: јас ја сакам, мајко, од срце.
lines.lat: jas ja sakam, majko, od srce.
lines.en: I love her, mother, from the heart.
May she bear me children,
may she continue my line, mother.
Set the table, mother,
fill the glasses.

lines.cyr: Бела лута ракија, рујно вино црвено,
lines.lat: Bela luta rakija, rujno vino crveno,
lines.en: White strong rakija, red ruby wine,

lines.cyr: сè до капка да се испие.
lines.lat: sè do kapka da se ispie.
lines.en: let it all be drunk to the last drop.
I brought you a young bride,

lines.cyr: јас ја сакам, мајко, од срце.
lines.lat: jas ja sakam, majko, od srce.
lines.en: I love her, mother, from the heart.
May she bear me children,
may she continue my line, mother.
Come on, mother, give a trill of joy for me (my reading)
and sing out strongly,

lines.cyr: нека сите те слушнат, нека сите разберат
lines.lat: neka site te slušnat, neka site razberat
lines.en: let everyone hear, let everyone understand
that you brought a daughter-in-law into the house.
I brought you a young bride,

lines.cyr: јас ја сакам, мајко, од срце.
lines.lat: jas ja sakam, majko, od srce.
lines.en: I love her, mother, from the heart.
May she bear me children,
may she continue my line, mother.
